messages:
evan: Heads-up: release/0.5.0 publish blocked by regen diffs after typegen 2.1.0 landed. CI shows small but widespread changes across SDKs (examples, sample-apps, and README snippets).

priya: saw that too. The weird bit: some generated example requests started including default fields (nulls/empty arrays) that used to be omitted. Tests that snapshot examples are failing.

tom: gist of diff: 
```json
- {"filters": [] }
+ {"filters": null }
```
This broke sample-apps quickstart tests which assert equality to the old fixtures.

evan: Is this a codegen change or typegen? Could be downstream marshaling behavior.

devex-bot: regen-check action: release/0.5.x failed (regen-compare). 14 files changed across node, python, go. Link: https://ci.internal/1792127890/regen

priya: traced to typegen change that normalizes absent collections to explicit null to match some language runtime defaults. That is a behavioral change and should have surfaced in a changelog.

tom: short-term options: revert typegen on release branch, patch codegen to normalize examples back to omitted for patch, or relax snapshot tests to ignore default-vs-omitted differences. Thoughts?
evan: prefer not to relax tests; that hides regressions. Revert hurts progress. I propose a small codegen transformation for the examples only: when emitting example fixtures, collapse language-default-null to omitted where previously omitted. Keeps user-facing published SDK shapes identical for patch.

priya: agreed. I'll open PR that post-processes examples in codegen templates (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/codegen/pull/2410). It runs during `make regen` and is opt-in behind a flag so we can remove when we cut a major.

devex-bot: release-bot marked 0.5.0 publish blocked until regen diffs are addressed.

tom: also adding a new devex script `scripts/regen-run-all.sh` that runs regen across languages and runs snapshots locally. That will be added to CI preflight and the release checklist.

evan: long-run: we need explicit semver policy for typegen. Any language-shape changes (pointer vs value, null vs omitted, naming) => major release or migration guide. File an RFC.

priya: filed RFC #1254: "typegen semver and language-shape policy". Also added a release-checklist change: run `./scripts/regen-run-all.sh` and confirm no example snapshot diffs.

ops-bot: note: scheduled a run of regen-checker on the release candidate branch every 6 hours while this is open.

tom: patched codegen merged, I ran `./scripts/regen-run-all.sh` locally and all sample-app tests passed. Pushed the regenerated fixtures.

devex-bot: CI re-run shows regen-compare clean on release/0.5.x. publish job resumed.

evan: publishing now. After this lands, let's add a small tutorial in devex docs about how to run regen locally for onboarding. Spotted multiple contributors who didn't know the command.

priya: created a tiny doc in devex handbook: "How to run regen and interpret diffs". Linking in PR.

evan: publish succeeded. Thanks all. Closing thread. :party_parrot:
